name: lernwerk-dtz
description: Offline-first DTZ A1-B1 German learning app prototype for Android and iOS via Capacitor.

scripts.api:compile: mkdir -p api-java/build && javac --add-modules jdk.httpserver -d api-java/build $(find api-java/src/main/java -name '*.java')
scripts.api:test: mkdir -p api-java/build && javac --add-modules jdk.httpserver -d api-java/build $(find api-java/src/main/java api-java/src/test/java -name '*.java') && java -ea -cp api-java/build de.lernwerk.dtz.LearningRulesSelfTest
scripts.api:run: npm run api:compile && java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp api-java/build de.lernwerk.dtz.DtzApiServer
